Specialists can outperform the recorded human reference on some levels
Broad, reliable human-level play is not yet established
22 human-covered levels; 21 evaluated specialists. Human rates pool repetitions from five participants, without population CIs.
Human speed includes successful respawn lives; starts, practice and budgets differ. 15 decisions/s is simulated game time, not inference speed.
Intervals reflect fixed-checkpoint trial uncertainty, not independent training runs. Missing model results are not zero scores. Source: docs/handoff/evidence.json.
